vy1.title: India has gone digital. Has your business?
vy1.body:
Your customers already do everything on the phone — they pay by UPI, they look for shops on Google, they ask on WhatsApp. A paper visiting card does none of that.

Shubhora puts your business where your customers already are: one link with your card, your products, your prices and a way to reach you at any hour.

vb1.title: The partner plan, explained
vb1.caption: In Hindi: free registration, Red and Green ID, the double binary, the daily cap, ranks and weekly payout — the whole plan, with its rules.

vb2.title: Why this business
vb2.body:
Every business around you — the shop you buy from, the clinic you visit, the agent you know — needs to be found and reached on the phone, and most still hand out paper cards. Shubhora partners show them this card and set theirs up on the spot.

There is no stock to buy, nothing to deliver and nothing to store: the product is a link. Registration is free. Income comes from real paid subscriptions and their renewals — every pair pays ₹500, and every renewal pays again. That is what makes it a lasting business.

items.name: Every business needs it
items.desc: India has 7.8 crore registered small businesses (Udyam, February 2026). Every one of them needs customers to find it and reach it.

items.name: Easy to deliver
items.desc: The product is a link. A customer's card is set up on their own phone in about 10 minutes — no stock, no courier, no installation.

items.name: Easy to show
items.desc: Your own card is the demo. Hand over your phone, let them tap around, and make theirs free on the spot.

items.name: Free to start
items.desc: Registration is free — nobody has to buy anything to join. Your ID turns Green when your own Standard plan is active.

items.name: Renewals count again
items.desc: When a customer renews Standard, that month's BV enters your renewal binary again — one sale keeps counting for as long as the customer stays subscribed and your own plan is active.

items.name: Paid every week
items.desc: Pairs are matched every night. After Sunday's closing, a wallet of ₹500 or more goes to your KYC-approved bank account on Wednesday.

items.name: Everything on your phone
items.desc: Your team, wallet, income reports, KYC and withdrawals are in the app's Business section.

items.name: Everything in writing
items.desc: The plan, the partner agreement and the disclosures are published — read them before you decide.

images.caption: Every paid subscription is 2,500 BV. 2,500 BV on your left + 2,500 BV on your right = one pair = ₹500. Up to 10 pairs a day in each binary — paid every week.

vb5.title: The plan at a glance
items: 🆓 Registration free — Red ID
🟢 Own Standard plan active — Green ID
🎁 Green ID: 25 AI credits per direct sale
🔁 Two binaries: new sales and renewals
📏 Up to 10 pairs a day in each binary
➡️ Unmatched BV carries forward
🏆 10 ranks on lifetime pairs
🏦 Weekly payout, Wednesday transfer
🧾 TDS as per law, no admin charge

vb6.title: The Shubhora presentation (PDF)
vb6.hint: 20 pages · the product, plans and prices, and the complete partner plan — BV, pairs, capping, ranks and payout rules · tap to download

items.a: Every pair pays ₹500. There are two binaries — new sales and renewals — each up to 10 pairs a day (₹5,000): up to ₹10,000 a day and ₹3,00,000 a month, paid every week to your bank. The more real businesses your team brings and keeps, the more you earn.
Yes. Nobody has to buy anything to join. Turn your own Standard plan on (Green ID) and every pair is paid.

items.q: Do I have to buy stock?
items.a: No. The product is software — there is nothing to buy in advance, nothing to deliver and nothing left over.

The card you are looking at: the free digital V-Card, the website plans (Website Standard ₹2,999 a year, Website Premium ₹5,999 a year) and the Growth Plan (₹2,999 a month) with the daily posters, the WhatsApp AI and the CRM.

items.q: When and how am I paid?
items.a: Matching runs every night. After Sunday's midnight closing, a wallet of ₹500 or more is paid out automatically and reaches your approved bank account on Wednesday. PAN and bank details (KYC) must be approved first.
Yes, TDS as per the Income Tax Act — 2% with PAN (20% without) once your yearly income crosses ₹20,000. There is no admin charge.

items.q: What if a customer takes a refund?
items.a: If a payment is refunded, the commission paid on it is reversed.

items.q: Do I need to be technical?
items.a: No. Everything happens on a phone, and the videos on this card show every step.

shubhoraPage.title: Why this business
shubhoraPage.body:
Every business around you — the shop you buy from, the clinic you visit, the agent you know — needs to be found and reached on the phone, and most still hand out paper cards. Shubhora partners show them this card and set theirs up on the spot.

There is no stock to buy, nothing to deliver and nothing to store: the product is a link. Registration is free. Income comes from real paid subscriptions and their renewals — every pair pays ₹500, and every renewal pays again. That is what makes it a lasting business.
